text: The site at https://litlfred.github.io/dth-hrh/ does not exist, so every dth-hrh IRI under it is dead. Move the iriBase to https://worldhealthorganization.github.io/dth-hrh/ (the live WHO site), regenerate what is derived from it, rewrite the ArchiMate links to the singular element/ and view/ paths the generator now writes, and point the who-iris glossary links at the WHO host. This is a mechanical IRI change (owner, IRI scan option 2A, 2026-11-18), not a change to any text.

changeSets.title: Move the IRI base to the WHO site (mechanical IRI change set)
